revision_notes: No source had been cited for the original score. African Business (Feb 2026) confirms a small, underfunded ecosystem: fewer than 100 active tech-enabled startups nationwide, no locally headquartered VC funds, minimal angel activity, annual disclosed startup investment below USD 5m, and financing dominated by small donor/government grants (USD 5,000-50,000). A Founder Institute pre-seed accelerator cohort is only just launching (Nov 2026), underlining the ecosystem's early stage. This evidence matches the "Emerging (some startups, limited funding, 1-2 hubs)" description well, so the code 2 is confirmed unchanged.
